metric.definition: Agent acceptance rate: the number of times the agent followed the unusual but harmless instruction divided by the total number of instructions (Sec. 4.2), over the 180 no-defense trials.

The undated 'GPT-4 Omni' resolves to gpt-4o-2024-05-13 under the pre-2024-10-02 rule, and that snapshot is still callable - but the judge PROMPT is in the missing appendix, so the ANALYSIS_PLAN's condition (judge callable AND its prompt printed) is only half met.
metric.original_location: Table 2 ('Agent's acceptance rate to unusual but harmless instruction depending on the defense strategy implemented'), row gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, column 'No defense': 64.4% +- 7pp; discussed in Sec. 4.2 as the one exception among the models

cost.prepare_note: not prepared - items and prompts unavailable; 540 = 180 trials x 3 seeds, plus an equal number of judge calls

open_points: Prompts unavailable in the paper text: the agent system prompt, the 6 harmless-but-unusual instructions and the GPT-4 Omni judge prompt are all in an appendix that the extracted camera-ready does not contain. Nothing can be copied verbatim. The arXiv preprint arXiv:2502.19145 carries the appendix and would have to be consulted first.

The items are not a dataset. Sec. 3.2 builds them by first running the authors' own multi-agent research simulation without intervention and then sampling 30 agents with exactly 7 messages of interaction history each. Those histories are simulation output, not a public release, and reproducing them means re-running the whole multi-agent framework - a different and much larger experiment than the single-call cell this study re-executes.

n_items = 180 is derived (5,400 trials / 30 combinations of 6 models x 5 defense conditions), not printed. It is consistent with the reported +-7pp interval under a binomial approximation, but a human should confirm it against the appendix before any comparison.
notes: The claim cell is well identified and the judge model is still callable, so this paper is only blocked on material that exists but is not in the file we have. If the appendix is obtained, the remaining work is ordinary: 180 single-shot agent calls plus 180 judge calls per seed, at roughly $12 for three seeds. The distinct Experiment 1 result (infection spread / system robustness, Table 1) is a different measurement on the same framework and is not in scope here.
